title: Community AI assistant
onlyOwner: Only the community owner can turn the assistant on/off
needPro: The AI assistant can only be turned on for communities on the Pro plan. You can still prepare content, personality and Q&A.
intro: The assistant answers members using this community's data (about, rules, lessons, posts, events, plus the Q&A and documents below). Paid/level lessons are only used for members who unlocked them. All members can chat; paid (VIP) members can choose a personality and ask more each day.
welcomePlaceholder: e.g. Hi, I'm Study Cat — ask me about lessons!
vipDailyHint: VIP = members with an active paid subscription (mods/admins are always VIP)
customHint: Write your own pronouns, tone and examples
vipPersonasHint: Regular members always use the default; VIP members can pick from this list.
extraHint: e.g. always remind members to do the end-of-lesson exercise. Cannot override safety rules.
tryHint: Open the assistant at the bottom-right of the community page to try it.
stats: {{qa}} Q&A · {{pending}} pending · {{docs}} documents · last 7 days: {{convs}} conversations, {{handoffs}} sent to owner
pToneHint: Describe the voice: casual or formal, short or long sentences, encouraging or not…
examples: Examples: Good / Too verbose / Too curt
examplesHint: The assistant learns rhythm and length from these (it won't copy numbers). 2–4 examples are enough.
exSituation: Situation (e.g. asks about a locked lesson)
qaHint: Questions close to a sample are answered instantly with your answer (no AI call).
candidateHint: Answers the assistant learned from conversations — used only after you approve.
question: Question
docsHint: Markdown; each '## Heading' section becomes a searchable chunk (schedule, submission process, FAQ…).
docContent:
# Schedule

## Class time
Every Tuesday at 8pm…
convsHint: The widget tells members the owner can read conversations with the assistant. Messages with personal info are hidden.
